thesis: Tetravus stores its power in detachable flying pieces, letting an artifact creature redistribute itself between one large body and several evasive threats.

canonicalIdentity.currentOracleText: Flying. This creature enters with three +1/+1 counters on it. At the beginning of your upkeep, you may remove any number of +1/+1 counters from this creature. If you do, create that many 1/1 colorless Tetravite artifact creature tokens. They each have flying and "This token can't be enchanted." At the beginning of your upkeep, you may exile any number of tokens created with this creature. If you do, put that many +1/+1 counters on this creature.
